name: HarborRank
tagline: Live SEO data for agents: keywords, SERPs, Maps rank grids, backlinks, audits, Search Console
description: Hosted SEO server for AI agents with 53 tools: keyword metrics (volume, difficulty, intent, trends), live Google results with People Also Ask and AI Overviews, Google Maps results and local rank grids, a domain's ranking keywords and backlinks, rank tracking with competitor positions, crawl-based site audits and real-user Core Web Vitals, AI visibility for a brand, and read-only Google Search Console and Google Analytics. Sign in with OAuth in the browser; no API key. New accounts start with a 7-day free trial.

install.notes: The first tool call opens a browser OAuth login. New accounts start a 7-day free trial at https://app.harborrank.com/sign-up.
